scenes.setting: Fleeing across bare fields, the old butler turns and finds the hooded figure waiting — his nose goes first, then his voice, then all of him, wiped from the world like a stain
scenes.text_anchor: not a single trace was left behind

scenes.setting: Azik's copper whistle buys one paper substitute's worth of life; the Shepherd's own suppressed injuries burst out in coughed-up organs, bullets fail against boneless flesh, and Klein throws himself off a fifty-meter cliff into the Tussock — only for gill-faced Mr. A to surface between him and the shore

A hooded woman appears above the water and erases the Shepherd like pencil under an eraser — then turns her expressionless black eyes on Klein and, impossibly, smiles before vanishing; alone on the remote bank he decides she must be a Church powerhouse sent in time
scenes.text_anchor: the corners of the woman’s mouth slowly lifted into a smile

scenes.setting: Azik is Exiled into the void rather than killed, and the two hurry to hide the site before the Church finds it — Zangwill unsteady, 0-08 reclaimed, and his ruined trousers heaped around his ankles
By the solarium windows a voice tells the prince to hurry; he looks out at the golf course and the strolling horses, sets the spirit-destroying bullet against his temple, and pulls the trigger
